title: MetricDataLink - Data API
description: The link between the metric and the data source, such as a report.

DatasourceFieldName.description: The field name of the data source, such as a report summary field.

DataSourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DataSourceId.description: The ID of the data source.

LastSynchronizationTime.description: The last time the data was synchronized.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, Sort
Name.description: The name given to the data link record.

TargetId.description: The ID of the metric that the data is linked to.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **MetricDataLinkHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
